The complete private candidate and collector now have verified exact byte identities. This draft preserves a content-free analysis of all 35 before/after pairs: 12 differ only in LastAccessTime, while the visible collector conjunction still rejects because all-fields stability is false. No canonical inventory, wrapper, writer or production source changed. The sole additional source member needed to finish the delegated Same/Named/Hash review is NativeMetadata.cs (6,163 bytes, SHA256 f551d7287611b982a93eebf02e93719bfdce355609bd7ca4f9cd546ae9bf0a4c). Its implementation, any supported adaptation and native admission remain HOLD.

The PostgreSQL continuation preserves eight fresh official metadata proxy403/zero-body failures, including detached Release/Release.gpg. It provides one bounded external evidence package: coherent signed release/key trust and same-release indices, conditional Sources-bound .dsc, provenance and exact prefix/loader/lifecycle support. Proposed handoff limits are seven raw metadata members/nine total, 4MiB decoded aggregate and 1.5MB per metadata member. These are evidence intake proposals, not transfer/setup authority or complete dependency closure. No target artifact was acquired or speculative launcher chosen.

Independent predicate review accepts only the facts/conjunction/offline verifier: 25 data, 16 independent inert, 19 author and 18 integrity checks pass. PGDG review 98/98 and exact author 63/63 pass. Root recount and 19 author controls pass; corrected exact-author audit 98/98 passes. Integrated 62/1 old-roadmap-pin failure and initial 96/2 wrong-root/historical-pin failures remain preserved with exact explanations. All 4 root-owned check groups are absent. Of 4,696 pre-existing files, 4,695 are byte-identical; the canonical roadmap is the sole existing-file change.

Predicate author/reviewer: 7591d8670e53fa49876aa762b0407b8baf2c66ba / 33e2ab2fbfa42c635f1ee69368da7fa24bc3cb91. PGDG author/reviewer: 76355bfe516260ba758dee44f9fcf454e317cd71 / e98df5f1502a732cc22d6bc6d3911e4e8e956bfc. Private bodies and personal paths remain outside Git; failed local relay transcriptions, original rejected observations and reviewer checker failures are preserved.

Stacked on PR19 at 15f671a65365e3401f0ce07b46deb4cf63538346. G0 accepted/G1 OPEN/G2–G7 unentered; 139 originals, 96 selected/43 deferred, 14 bound unavailable/82 unmapped; source connectivity disabled. No main merge, frontend change, native target action, SQL/migration, image/container, cloud/security/network/customer-data/provider action or spend.

Final document integration review: 1957a920ed6b46ef15ec634b1aa03b4ba44dc2ac, ACCEPT_DOCUMENT_INTEGRATION with 45/45 checks. Initial 37-pass/4-failure reviewer ancestry assumption is preserved and corrected to exact cherry-pick correspondence and byte identity. Source/evidence freeze 8c51a624917609090caa042a4ae9d88be9ca782a, tree d1e07f4672934c895a3a41a248d3af3edb894b84; all 92 manifest members verified.
